## Request

market and legal evidence. Current host model with preceding context,2026-11-04;
no subagents/providers or native accepted heads. Execution mode **Capital-Structure
RV**, status **Ready with Limitations for this historical pair comparison**.
This does not clear full matching CP-1/CP-2/current-underwriting gates. The checked

## Findings
### Security-selection view
**Both securities: Requires More Work; RV Unclear.** Positive comparative work
now establishes what the apparent compensation difference actually depends on.
If both annual equivalents are clean, July's maturity yield exceeds March's by
**2.210154bp**, but the same-date Treasury-tenor adjustment leaves only
**0.160839bp** of simple residual difference. Source fair values are rounded to
USDm: an analyst nearest-million display-precision sensitivity, varying each
value independently by±0.5USDm, makes the yield gap range from
**−0.616287 to5.036816bp**. A precise ordering is not supported in that case.
If both equivalents are dirty, July's extra yield is**18.522010bp** and simple
residual difference**16.472695bp**; rounding alone leaves that yield ordering
positive. That is the strongest compensation countercase for July, but neither
price basis nor executable depth is established. The basis need not be identical
across separately estimated values. July also has longer remaining maturity and
greater conditional duration, so a yield difference is not free compensation.
No current Cheap/Fair/Rich or Preferred label is justified by those alternatives.
### Fundamental credit summary — actual upstream context used
HL reports investment income2,990 versus2,614 USDm and NII1,403 versus1,266;
net operations1,522 in both years, diluted EPS2.44 versus2.68. Higher aggregate
NII is meaningful contrary evidence to a blanket deterioration view. It does
not settle per-share or cash durability. Non-accruals rose from1.3% to1.7% at
cost and0.6% to1.0% at fair value, while the internal average grade remained3.1
(A73,116). Investment marks and borrower realization affect the BDC's creditor
buffer; cost and fair-value non-accrual percentages are separate denominators.
HL's CFO used2,128 USDm versus provided511 includes investment deployment.
PIK recognition and collections have different timing/cohorts; no industrial
CFO-minus-capex burn rate or contemporaneous PIK cash-conversion percentage is
invented. Ordinary cash635 USDm differs from restricted225; approximately5.1USDbn
facility availability is conditional (A88,115,255). Neither is an unconditional
